# Tools reference

*Generated by `scripts/gen_tool_docs.js` from the schemas in `bots/agent/tools/`;
run `npm run docs` after changing a tool. `npm test` fails when this file is stale.*

The agent plays Minecraft only through these tools. Each turn the model
receives the list below as the API's tool definitions, calls one or more,
and gets every result back as JSON. How the loop sequences calls, events
and interrupts is described in [agent-loop.md](agent-loop.md); how a tool
is implemented on top of the world substrate is in
[world-substrate.md](world-substrate.md).

## Result shape

Every tool answers with one JSON object (`bots/agent/tools/result.js`):

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `status` | `ok`, `partial` (something useful happened, then it stopped), `failed`, `interrupted` (an event pulled the bot out), `unsupported` |
| `reason` | a stable machine token for anything but plain `ok` (for example `no_path`, `block_not_found`, `need_bucket`); the per-group lists below are the tokens each module declares |
| `by`, `detail` | only with `interrupted`: the event that fired and what it carried (a damage event carries hp, amount, cause, attacker) |
| `hint` | free text telling the model what to try next, when the tool knows |
| `elapsed_s` | wall time |
| other fields | tool-specific: positions, counts, what was gained, what remains |

Tools never throw to the loop: an exception becomes `failed` with
`reason: "exception:<message>"` so the transcript stays truthful and the
model always gets its turn back.

## Interrupts

Actuators (anything that takes time) accept `interrupt_on`, a list of
events that end the call early: `damage`, `chat_mention`, `whisper`, `chat_any`, `mob_near`, `player_near`, `hunger`.
Each tool has a default (shown as *interrupts* below); pass `[]` to stay
heads-down. Lava, drowning and death always interrupt, and a few tools are
*uninterruptible* (only death or shutdown cancel them) so an escape finishes
before the model gets to reconsider. Interrupted calls report what was
achieved before the event, and the event itself is delivered to the model
with the result. Events that do not interrupt (`dusk`, `dawn`, `job_done`,
faction messages) arrive as `[events]` lines with the next turn.

Tools marked *parallel-safe* may be called in the same turn as other tools;
everything else runs one at a time in the order the model asked.

## Perceive (`bots/agent/tools/perceive.js`)

Read the world: position, surroundings, inventory, recipes. Instant and free.

### look

Look around: position, health, food, time of day, spawn-protection status, nearby players and hostile mobs (with distance and compass direction), notable blocks within 8, what you are holding and wearing, and the last few chat lines. Use this when you need the scene; each tool result already carries a one-line status.

No inputs.

*interrupts:* none by default · *parallel-safe*

### scan

Find blocks of a type near you. Returns up to `max` positions sorted by distance, skipping blocks inside spawn protection, under water, or next to lava. Aliases: log/wood/tree, ore, crops, sugar_cane. Radius is capped at 64; the world is only loaded ~8 chunks around you, so nothing farther can be seen without walking.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `block` | string |  |  | yes | block name, e.g. log, stone, iron_ore, coal_ore, dirt, sand, chest, water |
| `radius` | integer | min 4, max 64 | `32` |  |  |
| `max` | integer | min 1, max 12 | `6` |  |  |
| `y_min` | integer |  |  |  |  |
| `y_max` | integer |  |  |  |  |

*interrupts:* none by default · *parallel-safe*

### inventory

Your inventory grouped by kind (tools, weapons, armor, blocks, ores/ingots, food, other), what you are wearing and holding, and free slots.

No inputs.

*interrupts:* none by default · *parallel-safe*

### recipes

Look up how to make an item (ingredients, whether a crafting table or furnace is needed, output count) and what you are still missing for `count` of it. Also tells you what tool a block needs to mine and what it drops. Ask with the 1.8 item name.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string |  |  | yes |  |
| `count` | integer | min 1 | `1` |  |  |

*interrupts:* none by default · *parallel-safe*

**Failure reasons this module declares:** `no_world`, `scan_error`, `unknown_block`, `unknown_item`.

## Move (`bots/agent/tools/move.js`)

Pathfinding through the world substrate (bots/world/movement.js), doors included.

### goto

Walk to a position (pathfinding, digs through simple terrain when allowed; uses your own front door in and out, never your walls; avoids deep water). Give x,z (y optional), or named: home|spawn (home = inside your house), or player: <name>. Stops within `range` blocks. Returns where you ended up and, when it could not get there, what is around you so you can decide.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number |  |  |  |  |
| `y` | number |  |  |  |  |
| `z` | number |  |  |  |  |
| `named` | one of `home`, `spawn` |  |  |  |  |
| `player` | string |  |  |  |  |
| `range` | number | min 0, max 8 | `1` |  |  |
| `timeout_s` | integer | min 5, max 180 | `45` |  |  |
| `interrupt_on` | array of `damage`, `chat_mention`, `whisper`, `chat_any`, `mob_near`, `player_near`, `hunger` |  |  |  | Events that pull you out of this action early. Default: ["damage"]. Pass [] to stay heads-down. |

*interrupts:* `damage`

### leave_spawn

Walk clear of the spawn protection zone (you cannot break or place blocks inside it, and digging is suppressed near its edge; you may spawn just outside the box but still within that margin). Every bot has its own exit heading, so a fleet fans out around spawn instead of crowding one side; pass direction to choose a side yourself (for example towards your home). Keeps walking until you are clear by a comfortable margin. Use this first after logging in at spawn.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `margin` | integer | min 8, max 128 | `48` |  | how far past the boundary to get |
| `direction` | one of `N`, `NE`, `E`, `SE`, `S`, `SW`, `W`, `NW` |  |  |  | only to leave on a specific side (for example towards your home); leave it out to use your own exact heading, which is what spreads the bots out |
| `timeout_s` | integer | min 30, max 300 | `150` |  |  |
| `interrupt_on` | array of `damage`, `chat_mention`, `whisper`, `chat_any`, `mob_near`, `player_near`, `hunger` |  |  |  | Events that pull you out of this action early. Default: ["damage"]. Pass [] to stay heads-down. |

*interrupts:* `damage`

### flee

Run away from a player, mob, or position until you are `distance` blocks from it. Use when a fight is not worth it.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string |  |  |  | player or mob name |
| `x` | number |  |  |  |  |
| `y` | number |  |  |  |  |
| `z` | number |  |  |  |  |
| `distance` | integer | min 5, max 60 | `20` |  |  |
| `timeout_s` | integer | min 5, max 60 | `15` |  |  |

*interrupts:* none by default

**Failure reasons this module declares:** `bad_target`, `no_home`, `no_position`, `player_not_visible`, `target_not_visible`.

## Escape (`bots/agent/tools/escape.js`)

Get out of holes, water, fence tops and dark places; teleports with arrival checks.

### unstick

Get out of a stuck spot. auto: standing on a fence, step off it; in deep water, swim to the nearest shore; if boxed in, dig one safe step sideways (or drop one block); if deep underground with a roof overhead, climb straight up placing blocks until the surface. Also: swim, sidestep, pillar (a short emergency pillar for headroom), surface (climb to target_y, default your home or y 63). Never digs into lava, bedrock, protection, or your own walls (inside your house you are not stuck: goto walks out through the door; force digs your walls anyway). Use after goto fails with noPath or when a tool reports you are wedged.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `strategy` | one of `auto`, `swim`, `sidestep`, `pillar`, `surface` |  | `"auto"` |  |  |
| `target_y` | integer | min 1, max 120 |  |  |  |
| `force` | boolean |  | `false` |  | allow digging your own walls (only when the doorway itself is blocked) |

*uninterruptible*

### teleport

Use the server teleport commands: home (/home, needs a set home) or spawn (/spawn). Stands still through the warm-up and verifies you arrived. The cheap way back to the surface after deep mining, and the way home from far away. Spawn is inside protection: leave_spawn afterwards.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `to` | one of `home`, `spawn` |  |  | yes |  |
| `timeout_s` | integer | min 5, max 30 | `12` |  |  |

*uninterruptible*

**Failure reasons this module declares:** `chat_failed`, `denied`, `no_position`, `no_teleport`, `own_walls`.

## Gather (`bots/agent/tools/gather.js`)

Mining, crafting, smelting, placing, digging, equipment, eating, chests, drops, torches. Thin wrappers over bots/world/primitives.js.

### mine

Mine `count` of a block type: finds the nearest safe one, walks there, equips the right tool, digs, collects the drops, and repeats. With vein=true (default) it clears the whole connected ore vein. Wanders to find the block if none is loaded nearby. Chunky: prefer count 8-32 over 1. Returns what was collected. Mining "stone" yields cobblestone.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `block` | string |  |  | yes | log, stone, cobblestone, dirt, sand, gravel, coal_ore, iron_ore, gold_ore, diamond_ore, reeds, wheat_seeds (sweeps tall grass in reach; count = seeds wanted), … |
| `count` | integer | min 1, max 64 | `8` |  |  |
| `vein` | boolean |  | `true` |  |  |
| `radius` | integer | min 8, max 96 | `48` |  |  |
| `timeout_s` | integer | min 15, max 600 |  |  |  |
| `interrupt_on` | array of `damage`, `chat_mention`, `whisper`, `chat_any`, `mob_near`, `player_near`, `hunger` |  |  |  | Events that pull you out of this action early. Default: ["damage"]. Pass [] to stay heads-down. |

*interrupts:* `damage`

### craft

Craft at least `count` ITEMS (not batches; recipes that make 4 per batch round up). If the recipe needs a crafting table and none is within 16 blocks, one is placed from inventory next to where you stand (fine in the field; near home, step inside first if you want it indoors). Use `recipes` first if unsure what is needed. Names: planks, stick, crafting_table, wooden_pickaxe, stone_pickaxe, stone_axe, stone_sword, furnace, chest, torch, wooden_door, iron_pickaxe, bread, …

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string |  |  | yes |  |
| `count` | integer | min 1, max 64 | `1` |  |  |

*interrupts:* none by default

### smelt

Smelt `count` of an item in a furnace. Finds one within 16 blocks, otherwise places one from inventory next to where you stand (a field furnace is fine when you are away; near home, step inside first if you want it indoors). Uses coal, or logs/planks as fuel. Blocks until done: 10 s per item. iron_ore → iron_ingot, raw food → cooked, sand → glass, cobblestone → stone.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string |  |  | yes |  |
| `count` | integer | min 1, max 64 | `1` |  |  |
| `fuel` | string |  |  |  | coal (default), log, planks |

*interrupts:* `damage`

### place

Place one block from inventory at x,y,z (needs a solid neighbor to place against; walks into range). block "water" pours a water bucket there (an empty bucket is filled at water within 16 blocks first): one source hydrates farmland within 4 blocks. For structures use `build` instead.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `block` | string |  |  | yes |  |
| `x` | integer |  |  | yes |  |
| `y` | integer |  |  | yes |  |
| `z` | integer |  |  | yes |  |

*interrupts:* none by default

### dig

Break one specific block at x,y,z (walks into range, equips the right tool, collects the drop). Refuses lava-adjacent and protected blocks, and refuses your own house walls unless force=true. For bulk gathering use `mine`.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | integer |  |  | yes |  |
| `y` | integer |  |  | yes |  |
| `z` | integer |  |  | yes |  |
| `force` | boolean |  | `false` |  |  |

*interrupts:* none by default

### equip

Hold an item (slot hand) or wear armor (head/torso/legs/feet). Tools are auto-equipped by mine/dig; use this for weapons or specific items.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string |  |  | yes |  |
| `slot` | one of `hand`, `head`, `torso`, `legs`, `feet` |  | `"hand"` |  |  |

*interrupts:* none by default

### wear_armor

Put on the best armor you are carrying, piece by piece (upgrades worse worn pieces).

No inputs.

*interrupts:* none by default

### eat

Eat the best food you carry. Auto-eat already handles hunger in the background; call this to top up before a fight or when the harness reports hunger with food in inventory.

No inputs.

*interrupts:* none by default

### store

Put items into a chest: named home (the chest in your house), the one at x,y,z, or the nearest within 16. items: "*" for everything except tools, weapons, armor, food, torches and workstations, or a list of item names. Walks there first.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | any |  | `"*"` |  |  |
| `named` | one of `home` |  |  |  |  |
| `x` | integer |  |  |  |  |
| `y` | integer |  |  |  |  |
| `z` | integer |  |  |  |  |

*interrupts:* `damage`

### withdraw

Take items out of a chest: named home, the one at x,y,z, or the nearest within 16. items: "*" for everything, or a list of item names; count caps each item.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | any |  | `"*"` |  |  |
| `count` | integer | min 0, max 64 |  |  | cap per item; 0 or omitted = all |
| `named` | one of `home` |  |  |  |  |
| `x` | integer |  |  |  |  |
| `y` | integer |  |  |  |  |
| `z` | integer |  |  |  |  |

*interrupts:* `damage`

### collect_drops

Walk over dropped items lying on the ground within `radius` and pick them up (e.g. after mining or a fight).

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | integer | min 2, max 24 | `8` |  |  |

*interrupts:* `damage`

### light_area

Place up to `max` torches on dark floor spots within `radius` so mobs stop spawning around you (tunnels, your base at night). Needs torches in inventory.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | integer | min 2, max 12 | `6` |  |  |
| `max` | integer | min 1, max 8 | `4` |  |  |

*interrupts:* `damage`

**Failure reasons this module declares:** `cell_occupied`, `eat_failed`, `faction_perm_denied`, `no_chest`, `no_food`, `no_home_chest`, `no_position`, `no_progress`, `no_torches`, `nothing_picked_up`, `nothing_taken`, `open_failed`, `own_structure`, `place_failed`, `too_close_to_home`, `unknown_block`, `unknown_recipe`, `unsupported`, `workstation`.

## Jobs (`bots/agent/tools/jobs.js`)

Long server-side work the bot does not have to stand next to: furnaces as jobs.

### smelt_start

Load a furnace with `count` of an item plus fuel and return immediately; the furnace cooks on its own (10 s per item) while you do other things. You get a job_done event when it should be ready, then call smelt_collect. Finds a furnace within 16 blocks or places one from inventory next to you. Fuel: coal (default), or logs/planks.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string |  |  | yes |  |
| `count` | integer | min 1, max 64 | `8` |  |  |
| `fuel` | string |  |  |  |  |

*interrupts:* `damage`

### smelt_collect

Walk to the furnace of a smelting job (default: the most recent) and take everything cooked so far. Reports what you got and how long is left if it is still cooking.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `job_id` | string |  |  |  |  |

*interrupts:* `damage`

### jobs

List background jobs (smelting) with status and seconds remaining.

No inputs.

*interrupts:* none by default · *parallel-safe*

**Failure reasons this module declares:** `empty`, `furnace_missing`, `load_failed`, `no_furnace_placed`, `no_input`, `no_job`, `not_enough_fuel`, `not_smeltable`, `nothing_ready_yet`, `open_error`, `still_cooking`, `unknown_item_def`.

## Build (`bots/agent/tools/build.js`)

Blueprints: list, survey a site, build (bots/building/).

### blueprints

List the structures you know how to build, with materials and what you are missing for each. Categories: base, farm, storage, defense, trap. Start with dirt_shelter or cobble_hut.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `category` | string |  |  |  |  |
| `id` | string |  |  |  | one blueprint for full details |

*interrupts:* none by default · *parallel-safe*

### survey_site

Find flat, unprotected ground for a blueprint near a spot (default: where you stand). Returns the anchor to pass to `build`, plus earthwork/vegetation to clear and what materials you still lack.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `blueprint` | string |  |  | yes |  |
| `x` | number |  |  |  |  |
| `z` | number |  |  |  |  |
| `radius` | integer | min 6, max 40 | `18` |  |  |

*interrupts:* none by default · *parallel-safe*

### build

Build a blueprint at an anchor (from survey_site; omit to resume the last build or auto-survey here). Clears the site, places blocks in order, and reports placed/failed counts, failure reasons, and what materials are still missing. Refuses to start without the materials. Chunky: one call is the whole structure; call again to resume after gathering more.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `blueprint` | string |  |  | yes |  |
| `x` | integer |  |  |  |  |
| `y` | integer |  |  |  |  |
| `z` | integer |  |  |  |  |
| `max_minutes` | integer | min 1, max 15 | `6` |  |  |
| `allow_dry` | boolean |  | `false` |  | build a farm without a bucket (the farmland will dry out until you place water) |
| `interrupt_on` | array of `damage`, `chat_mention`, `whisper`, `chat_any`, `mob_near`, `player_near`, `hunger` |  |  |  | Events that pull you out of this action early. Default: ["damage"]. Pass [] to stay heads-down. |

*interrupts:* `damage`

**Failure reasons this module declares:** `faction_perm_denied`, `missing_materials`, `need_bucket`, `need_hoe`, `no_builder`, `no_flat_site`, `no_position`, `no_registry`, `partial`, `site_unreachable`, `time_budget`, `too_close_to_spawn_protection`, `unknown_blueprint`.

## Farm (`bots/agent/tools/farm.js`)

Plant, harvest and tend a farm plot.

### farm

Work a farm plot. plant: sow seeds on every empty farmland cell within radius; harvest: break mature crops within radius, pick up the drops and replant; tend: harvest then plant. Reports empty and dry farmland left so you know what to fetch (seeds: mine wheat_seeds breaks tall grass; water: place water within 4 blocks of the plot, which needs a bucket). Crops grow by torchlight at night.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `plant`, `harvest`, `tend` |  | `"tend"` |  |  |
| `crop` | one of `wheat`, `carrots`, `potatoes` |  |  |  | which seeds to sow; default: whatever seeds you carry |
| `radius` | integer | min 4, max 32 | `12` |  |  |
| `timeout_s` | integer | min 15, max 600 | `180` |  |  |
| `interrupt_on` | array of `damage`, `chat_mention`, `whisper`, `chat_any`, `mob_near`, `player_near`, `hunger` |  |  |  | Events that pull you out of this action early. Default: ["damage"]. Pass [] to stay heads-down. |

*interrupts:* `damage`

**Failure reasons this module declares:** `no_farmland`, `no_position`.

## Fight (`bots/agent/tools/fight.js`)

Combat through bots/world/combat.js.

### attack

Fight a player or mob by name until it is dead, out of reach, or `timeout_s` passes. Combat handles aiming, chasing and swinging, and retreats on its own when your health gets low; being hit does not interrupt it. With until_clear (default) it keeps going for any other zombie/skeleton/spider within 6 blocks after the first dies, so one call clears a doorway. Creepers are never auto-targeted. Returns the outcome, kills, and both health values.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | string |  |  | yes | player name or mob name (zombie, skeleton, cow, …) |
| `timeout_s` | integer | min 5, max 120 | `30` |  |  |
| `until_clear` | boolean |  | `true` |  | after the target dies, fight other nearby hostiles too |

*uninterruptible*

**Failure reasons this module declares:** `died`, `engage_failed`, `no_combat`, `retreated_low_hp`, `target_not_visible`.

## Board (`bots/agent/tools/board.js`)

The economy and political picture through BotBridge queries.

### board

The server board: your balance, your baltop rank and the top players, every faction with power, land, members online, its relation to you and whether it is raidable (more land than power), who is online and where, and land claims around you. What a player learns from /balance, /baltop, /f list, /f map and the tab list. Check it before money or faction decisions; it costs nothing in-game.

## Faction (`bots/agent/tools/faction.js`)

Massive Factions commands, selling and paying, the shared faction notes.

### f

Factions commands with the server's reply. Actions: create <name> (costs $100; refused without the funds), claim (the chunk you stand in; costs 1 faction power), unclaim, invite <player> (exact name), join <faction> (needs an invite), leave, ally|enemy|neutral <faction>, home (teleport to the faction home), sethome (only inside your claim), info <faction>, who <player>, power (your own power and when the next chunk becomes affordable), rank <player> <rank> (leaders/officers: new members join as recruits who cannot build on faction land; rank them member so they can). Check board first for factions, relations, your faction's power and your balance.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `create`, `claim`, `unclaim`, `invite`, `join`, `leave`, `ally`, `enemy`, `neutral`, `home`, `sethome`, `info`, `who`, `power`, `rank` |  |  | yes |  |
| `name` | string | max length 40 |  |  | faction name or player name, depending on the action |
| `rank` | one of `recruit`, `member`, `officer`, `leader`, `promote`, `demote` |  |  |  | for rank: member (lets them build on faction land), officer, recruit, or promote/demote one step |

*interrupts:* none by default

### sell

Sell items for money with /sell hand (works anywhere). With no items given it sells your surplus above sensible reserves (crops fully; cobble above 64; ore/ingots above a reserve; never diamonds, tools, armor, or building materials during a build). Give items to sell specific things. Reports what sold, what it earned, and your new balance.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | array of string |  |  |  | item names; omit to sell surplus automatically |
| `ignore_reserves` | boolean |  | `false` |  | sell listed items entirely (still never diamonds/tools/armor) |

*interrupts:* `damage`

### pay

Pay another player with /pay. Use for trades you agreed in chat, faction dues, or favors. Reports the server reply and your new balance.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player` | string |  |  | yes |  |
| `amount` | number | min 1, max 100000 |  | yes |  |

*interrupts:* none by default

### faction_notes

The shared notes of your faction (all members read and write the same page): plans, who needs what, raid targets, stash locations. read shows the page; append adds a dated line under your name; write replaces the whole page. Needs a faction.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `read`, `append`, `write` |  |  | yes |  |
| `text` | string | max length 2000 |  |  |  |

*interrupts:* none by default · *parallel-safe*

**Failure reasons this module declares:** `already_in_faction`, `bad_name`, `bad_rank`, `balance_unknown`, `denied`, `empty`, `insufficient_funds`, `leave_failed`, `missing_name`, `no_faction`, `no_redis`, `no_reply`, `nothing_sold`, `player_not_found`, `redis_error`, `sold_but_no_amount_seen`, `too_long`, `unclear`, `unknown_action`, `unknown_faction`.

Consult your strategic mind: a slower, deeper pass over your notes, the board, and a question. Use before big decisions (found or join a faction, spend money, start a raid, pick the next multi-hour project) or when you feel stuck. Returns a memo. Costs nothing in-game; do not call it every turn.

| `question` | string | max length 400 |  | yes | what you are trying to decide |

*interrupts:* none by default · *parallel-safe*

**Failure reasons this module declares:** `empty_memo`, `no_strategist`, `strategist_error`.

## Scripts (`bots/agent/tools/script.js`)

Model-written JavaScript in a sandbox, and the saved-skill library (see docs/scripts-and-skills.md).

### run_script

Run JavaScript you write, in an isolated sandbox (no files, no network, no server commands, no paying) whose globals are your own tools (await tools.mine({block:'log',count:8}), tools.goto, tools.dig, tools.place, tools.craft, tools.withdraw, tools.store, tools.farm, …), me.* and world.* queries, sleep(ms), log(...) and cancelled(). See the Scripts section of your instructions for the API and the rules. For repetitive or multi-step jobs no single tool does: sort a chest, plant a cactus row, torch a tunnel every 8 blocks, fence a perimeter. Returns what the script returned plus its log and the tool calls it made. Stops at timeout_s (default 60, max 300) and on interrupts. When it worked, save_skill it.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | max length 12000 |  | yes | the body of an async function; use await on every tools.* call and sleep; return a summary object |
| `timeout_s` | integer | min 5, max 300 | `60` |  |  |
| `interrupt_on` | array of `damage`, `chat_mention`, `whisper`, `chat_any`, `mob_near`, `player_near`, `hunger` |  |  |  | Events that pull you out of this action early. Default: ["damage"]. Pass [] to stay heads-down. |

*interrupts:* `damage`

### save_skill

Save a script that worked as a named skill for every bot on this server (data/skills). Give the exact code you ran with run_script so it is marked verified. params documents the params object use_skill will pass (e.g. "{chest:{x,y,z}, keep:[item names]}"). Saving an existing name makes a new version.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |  | yes | snake_case, 3-32 chars |
| `description` | string | max length 300 |  | yes |  |
| `code` | string | max length 12000 |  | yes |  |
| `params` | string | max length 300 |  |  | what params the skill reads, in one line |

*interrupts:* none by default · *parallel-safe*

### skills

List or search the saved skills every bot shares, with how often each worked (ok/failed) and who wrote it. Run one with use_skill. Prefer proven ones; read the code with show=true before trusting a stranger's.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | max length 80 |  |  | words to match in the name or description; empty lists everything |
| `show` | string | max length 32 |  |  | a skill name whose code you want to read |

*interrupts:* none by default · *parallel-safe*

### use_skill

Run a saved skill by name with a params object (see its params line in skills). Same sandbox, timeout and interrupts as run_script; the outcome is tallied on the skill.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | max length 32 |  | yes |  |
| `params` | object |  |  |  |  |
| `timeout_s` | integer | min 5, max 300 | `60` |  |  |
| `interrupt_on` | array of `damage`, `chat_mention`, `whisper`, `chat_any`, `mob_near`, `player_near`, `hunger` |  |  |  | Events that pull you out of this action early. Default: ["damage"]. Pass [] to stay heads-down. |

*interrupts:* `damage`

**Failure reasons this module declares:** `bad_name`, `no_skill_store`, `not_ready`, `skill_disabled`, `unknown_skill`.

## Mind (`bots/agent/tools/mind.js`)

Focus card, journal notes, waiting, logging off.

### focus

Set your focus card: what you are doing, why, the next 2-3 steps, and anything blocking you. Keep it under ~60 words. The harness shows it back to you after long stretches, after context trimming, and at your next login, so it is how you hold a plan across sessions.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | max length 600 |  | yes |  |

*interrupts:* none by default · *parallel-safe*

### note

Append one dated line to /memories/journal.md; the last dozen lines are shown at login. Use for events worth keeping: who paid you, who killed you, what you finished. For structured facts you will edit later (plans, places, people) use the memory tool on its own files.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | max length 300 |  | yes |  |

*interrupts:* none by default · *parallel-safe*

### wait

Deliberately idle for `seconds` while waiting for one specific thing (a smelt job, a player who said they are coming, crops). Not for passing the night: idle time earns nothing; mine underground with torches, smelt, craft, farm by torchlight, sell or plan instead. Interrupts pull you out early; default is any damage or chat mention.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `seconds` | integer | min 5, max 600 | `30` | yes |  |
| `interrupt_on` | array of `damage`, `chat_mention`, `whisper`, `chat_any`, `mob_near`, `player_near`, `hunger` |  |  |  | Events that pull you out of this action early. Default: ["damage"]. Pass [] to stay heads-down. |

*interrupts:* `damage`, `chat_mention`, `whisper`

### logoff

End your play session (as a player would: gtg, dinner, bed). Writes a journal line. The session ends after this call.

| Input | Type | Constraints | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reason` | string | max length 200 |  |  |  |

*interrupts:* none by default

**Failure reasons this module declares:** `empty`, `write_failed`.

## Memory (`memory`)

Anthropic's memory tool (`memory_20250818`), backed by `bots/agent/memoryTool.js`
over `data/memory/<bot>/`. The model sees the API's built-in definition,
not a schema of ours; on Gemini the adapter exposes the same commands as an
ordinary function. Commands: `view`, `create`, `str_replace`, `insert`,
`delete`, `rename`, all under the virtual `/memories` directory. The
prompt asks the bot to keep `plans.md`, `places.md` and `people.md`;
`note` and `logoff` append to `journal.md`. The login bootstrap lists the
files. Errors come back as `status: failed, reason: memory_error` with the
store's message. *parallel-safe*
